text:
Jin Park: Kicking off the 'mosaic' recurring-patterns retro — quarterly scan done. I pulled fingerprints and we have 18 incidents grouped into 4 signatures. Need owners + short timelines.

Sam Rivera: Share the quick breakdown please?

Jin Park: Top signatures: 1) KV cache eviction storms -> latency spikes (7 incidents). 2) Autoscale cold-start storms during deploys (5 incidents). 3) Model-variant fallback thrash (4 incidents where quantized variant incompatibilities caused fallbacks). 4) Tokenization/regression bursts causing quality alerts (2 incidents).

Maria Thompson: Added links to the annotated postmortems: https://redwood-internal/pm/mosaic-q1 (eng access). Exported incident fingerprints and recurrence scores.

Devon Li: I'll take KV cache mitigation. Plan: quick guardrails (rate-limit prefix writes, short-term ttl changes) + config rollout for smarter eviction. Proposed ETA: quick mitigation 72h, full rollout 21 days. Owner: @Devon Li.

Alex Koenig: Split looks good — please open a short-lived PR for the 72h quick fix so SRE can canary it.

Devon Li: Will do. Quick PR within 24h.

Sam Rivera: I'll own autoscale cold-starts. Proposal: pre-warm policy for hot models + warm pool sizing + deploy gating. ETA 28 days incl. cost analysis. Owner: @Sam Rivera.

Maria Thompson: I'll own the model-variant compatibility checks (artifact tagging + CI gate + alerting). ETA 14 days for gating + 7 days to onboard top-5 models. Owner: @Maria Thompson.

Jin Park: Tokenization regressions need Product/Research. @Alex Koenig can you coordinate a sync with Eng-ML?

Alex Koenig: Yep — scheduling a 30m sync this week with Eng-ML + Product.

Nora Bot: Quarterly pattern scan attached: `patterns-mosaic-q1.csv`. Summary metrics: total incidents=18, avg time-to-detect=9h (target 2h), recurrence median=3 incidents/signature.

Sam Rivera: Action-item recap (please confirm):
- Devon: KV quick mitigation (72h) + full rollout (21d)
- Sam: Autoscale warm pools & gating (28d) + cost estimate
- Maria: Variant gating (14d) + onboarding top5 (7d)
- Alex: Tokenizer sync + triage (this week)

Jin Park: I'll track these in the postmortem follow-up board and add deadlines. Please add PR/issue links as you create them and set the 'recurrence score' label (0-10). We'll reconvene in 2 weeks for a status check.

Devon Li: Created issue INC-8421: https://redwood-internal/issue/8421 — covers quick mitigation & monitoring.

Sam Rivera: Draft runbook up: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/autoscale-warmpools — comments welcome.

Maria Thompson: Gating PR opened: https://git.redwood/model-ci/pull/317 (tag: model-compat-check).

Alex Koenig: Tokenizer sync scheduled: Fri 10am PST. Calendar invite sent to Eng-ML + Product.

Jin Park: Please add a 'recurrence score' field to each issue. I'll add a template for consistency. Also propose we add an automated weekly pattern digest to the incidents channel.

Sam Rivera: +1 to weekly digest.

Devon Li: +1 :rocket:

Nora Bot: Reminder created: 2-week follow-up meeting -> unix ts 1913500000.

Jin Park: Thanks all — closing this thread for now. Keep updates inline here and on the follow-up board.
